chunks: And why should I fear those you associate with Him when you fear not associating others with God for which He has sent down no sanction? Tell me, whose way is the way of peace, if you have the knowledge?
ai.seo_question: What is the logical argument for why idolaters should fear shirk more than the Prophet fears their idols?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the logical inconsistency of polytheists who fear the consequences of their idols yet remain indifferent to the divine sanction of shirk itself. It underscores the concept of *al-amn* (security) as a divine privilege granted to those who recognize God's unity, contrasting the Prophet's fear of divine displeasure with the idolaters' complacency. The rhetorical question challenges the listener to identify the party truly entitled to peace based on epistemic clarity rather than mere tradition.
